highlights.text: Received unexpected praise and a special 'rockstar' moment from Salman Khan.
Salman Khan compared his career struggle to John Travolta and Bobby Deol.
An old video of him with Arijit Singh from Fame Gurukul went viral.
Was lauded by Salman Khan as the show's 'only rockstar', with Salman mimicking his famous 'Owww' line.
Recalled his close bond with Arijit Singh, sharing that the singer can play the sitar for 7 hours straight.
Confused fans after making claims about having a wife and children.
Was sent to the medical room following an acting stunt that sparked widespread internet reactions.
Recalled his Fame Gurukul victory over Arijit Singh and reflected on his journey.
Threatened Aasif Khan during an intense battle in the captaincy task.
Amused housemates and fans by hilariously trying to explain Gen Z terms like 'situationship' and 'benching'.
Was called out by Amrapali Dubey for exuding bad energy.
Defended his dramatic behavior inside the house as part of his game strategy.
Almost got into a physical fight and pushed Aasif Khan during a heated captaincy task
Scared housemates with an 'Oscar-level' performance, claiming 'main normal insaan nahi hoon'
Got into an intense fight with Yung DSA during the first captaincy task.
Shalin Bhanot reacted to being compared to Qazi Touqeer in the house.
Engaged in a heated argument with Yung DSA after mimicry led to a personal confrontation.
Involved in a verbal conflict with Kanika Mann after she expressed her dislike towards him.
